verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.agentmail.to (HTTP 200) that describes AgentMail as an email API for AI agents. Every doc page is served as a raw .md URL, and an OpenAPI spec is published at openapi.json. The quickstart is also written so the agent itself can register and get its own API key, inbox ID and organization ID, which makes the docs agent-oriented by design. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume llms.txt or the .md docs successfully.
